verification.subject: Confirm your email address
verification.heading: Confirm your email address
verification.body: Enter this code in Soirely to show the address is yours.
verification.expiry: It works for {minutes} minutes, and only once.
verification.ignore: If you did not create a Soirely account, nothing happens if you ignore this.
verification.text: Your Soirely code is {code}. It works for {minutes} minutes.
recovery.link.subject: Set a new Soirely password
recovery.link.heading: Set a new password
recovery.link.body: Somebody asked to reset the password for this Soirely account. Open this link to set a new one:
recovery.link.expiry: It works for {minutes} minutes, and only once.
recovery.link.ignore: If you did not ask, ignore this email. Your password stays as it is.
recovery.provider.subject: How you sign in to Soirely
recovery.provider.body: Somebody asked to reset the password for this Soirely account, but it has no password: you sign in with {providers}. Use that button on the sign-in screen.
recovery.provider.ignore: If you did not ask, you can ignore this email.
recovery.changed.subject: Your Soirely password was changed
recovery.changed.body: The password for this Soirely account was changed on {when}. Every other device has been signed out.
recovery.changed.notYou: If this was not you, reset your password again straight away.
twoFactor.off.subject: Two-factor authentication was turned off
twoFactor.off.body: Two-factor authentication was turned off for your Soirely account on {when}. Signing in now asks only for your password, Google or Apple.
twoFactor.off.notYou: If this was not you, reset your password and turn two-factor back on from Settings > Security.
alreadyRegistered.subject: You already have a Soirely account
alreadyRegistered.body: Someone tried to create a Soirely account with this address. You already have one. Sign in, or reset your password if you've forgotten it.
alreadyRegistered.ignore: If this wasn't you, you can ignore this email.
password.changed.subject: Your Soirely password was changed
password.changed.body: The password for this Soirely account was changed on {when}.
password.changed.devices: Every other device has been signed out.
password.changed.notYou: If this was not you, reset your password now: choose "Forgot your password?" on sign-in, using this address. That signs out every device, including whoever changed it.
password.device.unknown: A device that did not name itself
password.code.subject: Your Soirely code
password.code.body: Enter this code in Soirely to add a password to your account:
password.code.ignore: If you did not ask to add a password, you can ignore this email. Nothing changes without the code.
password.added.subject: A password was added to your Soirely account
password.added.body: A password was added to this Soirely account on {when}. You can now sign in with it as well.
password.added.notYou: If this was not you, reset your password now: choose "Forgot your password?" on sign-in, using this address.
provider.linked.subject: {provider} is now linked to your Soirely account
provider.linked.body: {provider} is now linked to your account. You can sign in to Soirely with this {provider} account.
provider.unlinked.subject: {provider} is no longer linked to your Soirely account
provider.unlinked.body: {provider} is no longer linked to your account. You can't sign in to Soirely with this {provider} account any more, and devices that signed in with it are signed out.
provider.linked.notYou: If this wasn't you, change your password and unlink {provider} from Security.
provider.linked.notYouNoPassword: If this wasn't you, unlink {provider} from Security and sign out any devices you don't recognise.
provider.unlinked.notYou: If this wasn't you, change your password and check Security.
provider.unlinked.notYouNoPassword: If this wasn't you, check Security and sign out any devices you don't recognise.
provider.why: You're getting this because the ways you sign in to Soirely changed.
twoFactorRecovery.code.subject: Your code to get back into Soirely
twoFactorRecovery.code.body: Enter this code in Soirely to ask to get back in without your authenticator:
twoFactorRecovery.code.notYou: If you didn't ask for this, somebody knows your password. Change it, and cancel the request:
twoFactorRecovery.started.subject: A request to get into your Soirely account
twoFactorRecovery.started.heading: Somebody asked to get into your account without two-factor
twoFactorRecovery.started.body: The request said the authenticator and the recovery codes are lost. Your account stays signed out until an owner or admin of your organisation approves it.
twoFactorRecovery.started.after: If this was you, there is nothing more to do. We email you when somebody answers.
twoFactorRecovery.approver.subject: {name} asked to get back into their account
twoFactorRecovery.approver.heading: {name} needs you to confirm it's them
twoFactorRecovery.approver.bodyBoth: They lost their authenticator and their recovery codes, and proved their email address and phone with codes. Approving turns off their two-factor and signs them out everywhere. They then sign in again and can set it up afresh.
twoFactorRecovery.approver.bodyEmail: They lost their authenticator and their recovery codes, and proved their email address with a code. They have no verified phone. Approving turns off their two-factor and signs them out everywhere. They then sign in again and can set it up afresh.
twoFactorRecovery.approver.after: Only approve if you're sure it's them. If you're not, ask them on a number you already have. One approval is enough, and any owner or admin can turn it down.
twoFactorRecovery.approver.footer: You're getting this because you're an owner or admin of {organisation}.
twoFactorRecovery.approved.subject: Your request was approved
twoFactorRecovery.approved.heading: Your request was approved
twoFactorRecovery.approved.body: Two-factor is off and every session has ended. Sign in again with your password, Google or Apple, and set up two-factor again.
twoFactorRecovery.off.subject: Two-factor is off for your Soirely account
twoFactorRecovery.off.heading: Two-factor is off
twoFactorRecovery.off.body: Your recovery codes no longer work. Set up two-factor again in Security once you have signed in.
twoFactorRecovery.turnedDown.subject: Your request was turned down
twoFactorRecovery.turnedDown.heading: Your request was turned down
twoFactorRecovery.turnedDown.body: Nothing about your account changed. If you still need to get in, talk to an owner or admin of your organisation, then start a new request from the sign-in code screen.
twoFactorRecovery.expired.subject: Your request has expired
twoFactorRecovery.expired.heading: Your request has expired
twoFactorRecovery.expired.body: Nobody approved it within 7 days, so nothing changed. You can start a new request from the sign-in code screen.
twoFactorRecovery.notMeNote: Cancels any request that is waiting and signs out every session.
twoFactorRecovery.footer: You're getting this because of a change to how your Soirely account signs in.
newDevice.subject: New sign-in to Soirely
newDevice.body: Your Soirely account was signed in to on a device it hasn't seen before.
newDevice.notYou: If this wasn't you, change your password and sign out the devices you don't recognise.
newDevice.notYouNoPassword: If this wasn't you, sign out the devices you don't recognise from Security.
newDevice.why: You're getting this because a new device signed in to your Soirely account.
